command: echo CONFIG; grep -E '^(ENTITYOS_MACHINE_NAME|ENTITYOS_DATA_DIR|ENTITYOS_COGNITION_DIR|ENTITYOS_VOICE_DIR|ENTITYOS_IDENTITY_BINDS)=' /etc/entityos/entityos.conf 2>/dev/null || true; echo DBS; find /var/lib/entityos -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -name '*.db' -o -name '*.sqlite' -o -name '*.sqlite3' \) -printf '%p %s bytes\n' 2>/dev/null | sort | head -100; echo POINTERS; find /var/lib/entityos -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -name '*db*pfad*' -o -name '*locator*' -o -name '*state*root*' \) -printf '%p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort | head -100
